meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and Orca's embedded browser through the `orca` CLI. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "handoff" / "handover" / "give this to another agent", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", or "share skills". Prefer it over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use when Orca state is involved. Use Computer Use only when a visible window needs GUI control that a CLI, filesystem, or API cannot do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把编码任务放进独立工作区,让多个助手并行推进并互相交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时用多个编码助手,想让他们分工又方便交接
copy.tagline_en: Run coding tasks in isolated workspaces and hand them off between assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle several coding assistants and want them to split work and hand off

howto.what: Claude 会先按会话确定该用哪个 orca 可执行文件、加载版本匹配的指南，再通过 `orca` 命令行操作 Orca 管理的工作树、终端、仓库、产物与内置浏览器等。
howto.when: 当你提到「$orca-cli」「Orca worktree」「child worktree」等关键词，或要求在工作树里派生 codex/claude、读写 Orca 终端、交接给其他 agent 时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看当前有哪些 Orca 工作树
say.note: 会解析可执行文件并列出工作树

say.text: 在这个工作树里派生一个 claude 干活
say.note: 通过 orca CLI 新建子工作树并启动

say.text: 把这条任务的上下文交接给另一个 agent
say.note: 走 orca 的 handoff 流程

howto.what_en: Claude resolves which orca executable to use, loads the version-matched guide, then operates Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repos, artifacts, skill sharing and the embedded browser via the `orca` CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree" and similar, or ask to spawn codex/claude in a worktree, read or send an Orca terminal, or hand off to another agent.

say_en.text: Show me which Orca worktrees exist right now
say_en.note: Resolves the executable and lists worktrees

say_en.text: Spawn a claude in this worktree to do the work
say_en.note: Creates a child worktree via the orca CLI

say_en.text: Hand this task's context off to another agent
